en: Imagine you get a big, yummy cookie! What would you want for your best friend?
None of you truly believes, until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.
So if you love a yummy cookie, share some with your friend too!
If you love being picked to play, pick your friend too!
And if you love kind words, say kind words to your friend!
So always want for others, what you want for yourself.
What will you share with a friend today?
